posts: $NEAR is still respecting the daily higher-low. Spot bids stay staged near that level — if it breaks, I'd rather sit out than average down into weakness. Levels over vibes.
Idle spot is wasted spot. #rhea rates still make parking spare $NEAR there the calm play while I wait for my level. No leverage, no rush — just carry.

replies.text: Green screens are easy; defined risk is hard. I'll chart $YAP once it prints a range with real depth — until then my levels stay on $NEAR.
